annotation.interpretation_a: An implementation must support all options that are currently defined in any RFC, even if those RFCs are experimental or obsolete.
annotation.interpretation_b: An implementation must support all options that are currently defined in a standards-track RFC.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'any currently defined options' is vague. It's unclear whether 'currently defined' refers to all RFCs that *have* defined options at any point, or only those options defined in RFCs that are currently valid (e.g., not obsoleted or experimental). This impacts the implementation's required support.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'currently defined options' is not precise. Does it include experimental, draft, or obsolete options? This affects the scope of the MUST requirement.
